name: spoil-heap-haul
description: Spoil heap (#1530): a player places the crewless Spoil Heap from the Build menu with an empty roster; it stands at once, with no construction order, for its flat price.

steps.description: Fresh site, no roster at all: a spoil heap takes no crew, so nobody has to be hired for it to be built.

Open the Build menu, buy the Spoil Heap card, pick a tile and confirm. Unlike every crewed building, confirming places it immediately: no construction site is queued (orderedBuildingCount stays 0) and the price is charged in full.

expect.note: Crewless placement: the heap exists straight away, with an empty roster.

steps.description: Read back the world: one standing building, nothing queued.
